evidence: An unbiased proteomic analysis of PAD4 in human monocytes: novel substrates, binding partners and subcellular localizations
Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were separated using Ficoll-Pacque (GE Healthcare) density gradient centrifugation.
monocytes from three healthy donors were incubated in calcium, fractionated and assessed for proteins in the isolated organelle fractions by mass spectrometry.
